notes.v1_05: Detective: Make the desk a soft, light blue-grey painted wood in place of the glossy orange-brown. Paint the trench coat as smooth matte tan with fewer seams and plain small buckles. Replace the filing cabinet and potted plant with more of the plain blue wall. Keep the chicken with the camera, the magnifier and the cake stand.
notes.v1_06: Sheep and Cow: Replace the straw floor with soft green grass, leaving a small patch of packed dirt around the hoofprint and only a few straw wisps. Replace the red barn and hay bales on the right with soft green trees. Keep the sheep, the cow, the magnifiers and the blue sky.
notes.v1_03: Tea with the Pig: Replace the pink blossom canopy with a green leafy tree, and remove the pink petals from the grass. Make the tablecloth plain white. Keep the man, the pig, the tea set and the blue sky.
notes.v1_04: Grand Ball: Make the floor a slightly cooler, softer grey-brown wood with faint, blurred reflections. Paint the ballroom walls a pale blue-grey. Light the dancers from the upper left so their right sides fall into soft shade. Keep the dance pose, the bonnet, the bow tie and the green curtains.
notes.v1_01: Sheriff Pals: Paint the saloon front faded blue-grey wood with white trim, in place of red. Make the deck boards soft, weathered grey-brown wood with faint plank lines. Keep the man, the pig, the hats, the mug and the blue sky.
notes.v1_02: Ranch Hands: Paint the hay bale as a few large, soft golden clumps with gentle shading, and remove the rope. Replace the red barn and fence with soft green bushes and more blue sky. Make the bucket plain matte grey metal with one soft highlight. Keep the rooster, the cow, the bandana and the tree.
